name: power-avatar-growth
description: Verify server-owned logarithmic hero growth follows Power, remains below the shortest wall, survives respawn, preserves ground contact, and never enlarges equipped pets.

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local r=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation:Invoke('PowerGrowthRigContract') assert(r.ok,'R6/R15 growth contract failed '..H:JSONEncode(r)) return H:JSONEncode(r)

steps.label: R6 R15 and tall R15 obey the core-body growth cap

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local RS=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage') local G=require(RS.GameConfig) local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] c:Invoke('Reset') c:Invoke('SetStats',{Power=15,WallLevel=1}) task.wait(.25) local character=p.Character local root=character.HumanoidRootPart root.Anchored=true local world=workspace.PunchWallRPG local block=world['Depth Blocks'].DepthBlock_L001_C06_R01 local boss=world.Walls['Titan Server Wall'] local passageHeight=block.Size.Y*2 local powers={15,1500,150000,1.5e7,1.5e9,1e15} local rows={} local monotonic=true local bounded=true local grounded=true local directScaleValid=true local previous=0 for _,power in ipairs(powers) do local before=c:Invoke('PowerGrowthSnapshot') c:Invoke('SetStats',{Power=power}) task.wait(.18) local after=c:Invoke('PowerGrowthSnapshot') local _,size=character:GetBoundingBox() local applied=after.appliedMultiplier or 0 local directScale=character:GetScale() local baseScale=character:GetAttribute('PowerGrowthBaseModelScale') or directScale local expected=G.PlayerGrowthMultiplier(power) local bodyHeight=after.bodyHeight or 99 directScaleValid=directScaleValid and math.abs(directScale/baseScale-applied)<=.003 monotonic=monotonic and applied+0.003>=previous bounded=bounded and bodyHeight<=passageHeight-G.PlayerGrowth.GameplayClearanceMarginStuds+.05 and bodyHeight<=boss.Size.Y-G.PlayerGrowth.WallClearanceStuds+.05 grounded=grounded and math.abs((after.coreBottom or 99)-(before.coreBottom or 0))<=.08 rows[#rows+1]={power=power,expected=expected,applied=applied,directScale=directScale,bodyHeight=bodyHeight,visualHeight=size.Y,bottomDelta=(after.coreBottom or 99)-(before.coreBottom or 0),aura=(root:FindFirstChild('Kaiju Growth Aura') and root['Kaiju Growth Aura'].Enabled) or false} previous=applied end local beforeLevel=character:GetAttribute('PowerGrowthAppliedMultiplier') c:Invoke('SetStats',{WallLevel=99}) task.wait(.18) local afterLevel=character:GetAttribute('PowerGrowthAppliedMultiplier') local result={valid=monotonic and bounded and grounded and directScaleValid and rows[1].applied>=.99 and rows[#rows].applied>rows[1].applied+.18 and math.abs(beforeLevel-afterLevel)<.003 and character:GetAttribute('PowerGrowthPower')==1e15 and character:GetAttribute('PowerGrowthVersion')==G.PlayerGrowth.Version,monotonic=monotonic,bounded=bounded,grounded=grounded,directScaleValid=directScaleValid,passageHeight=passageHeight,bossWallHeight=boss.Size.Y,maximumHeight=character:GetAttribute('PowerGrowthMaximumHeight'),wallLevelIndependent=math.abs(beforeLevel-afterLevel)<.003,sourcePower=character:GetAttribute('PowerGrowthPower'),version=character:GetAttribute('PowerGrowthVersion'),rows=rows} root.Anchored=false assert(result.valid,'Power growth matrix failed '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)

steps.label: Power growth is monotonic grounded and shorter than every normal wall

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] c:Invoke('Reset') c:Invoke('ResetWorld') c:Invoke('SetStats',{Power=15,WallLevel=1,CritChance=0,FistMultiplier=1,PetMultiplier=0}) local character=p.Character local root=character.HumanoidRootPart root.Anchored=false root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero root.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(-2,3,-27),Vector3.new(-2,3,-100)) p:SetAttribute('LastWallHit',0) task.defer(function() c:Invoke('SetStats',{Power=1.5e9}) end) local punch=c:Invoke('PunchRadius') task.wait(.9) local autoOk,auto=pcall(function() return root:GetNetworkOwnershipAuto() end) local overlap=OverlapParams.new() overlap.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances={workspace.PunchWallRPG['Depth Blocks']} local stuck=0 local cf,size=character:GetBoundingBox() for _,block in ipairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(cf,size,overlap)) do if block.CanCollide and not block:GetAttribute('Broken') then stuck+=1 end end local applied=character:GetAttribute('PowerGrowthAppliedMultiplier') or 0 local valid=punch.ok and applied>1.18 and character:GetAttribute('DepthActiveCollisionGroup')=='PlayerCharacters' and character:GetAttribute('PowerGrowthServerOwnershipHeld')~=true and autoOk and auto==true and stuck==0 local result={valid=valid,punch=punch.ok,applied=applied,collisionGroup=character:GetAttribute('DepthActiveCollisionGroup'),deferred=character:GetAttribute('PowerGrowthDeferredForPunch'),serverOwnershipHeld=character:GetAttribute('PowerGrowthServerOwnershipHeld'),ownershipAuto=auto,stuck=stuck} assert(valid,'Concurrent punch growth failed '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)

steps.label: Power growth waits for punch ownership and restores physics

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation c:Invoke('Reset') c:Invoke('SetStats',{Power=15}) local names={'Forest Pup','Miner Cat','Crystal Fox'} local granted=0 for _,name in ipairs(names) do local r=c:Invoke('GrantPet',{name=name,stars=1}) if r.ok then granted+=1 end end task.wait(.25) return H:JSONEncode({ok=granted==3,granted=granted})

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild(p.Name..' Client Companions') local count=0 for _,m in ipairs(folder and folder:GetChildren() or {}) do if m:IsA('Model') then local _,size=m:GetBoundingBox() m:SetAttribute('GrowthQCBaselineModelScale',m:GetScale()) m:SetAttribute('GrowthQCBaselineHeight',size.Y) m:SetAttribute('GrowthQCBaselineTargetHeight',m:GetAttribute('CompanionTargetHeight')) count+=1 end end return H:JSONEncode({ok=count==3,count=count})

steps.label: record pet size before hero growth

args.code: local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation c:Invoke('SetStats',{Power=1e15}) task.wait(.25) return true

steps.label: raise hero to maximum configured Power
wait for hero and pet presentation update

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local character=p.Character local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild(p.Name..' Client Companions') local expected={['Forest Pup']=true,['Miner Cat']=true,['Crystal Fox']=true} local seen={} local rows={} local fixed=true local identities=true for _,m in ipairs(folder and folder:GetChildren() or {}) do if m:IsA('Model') then local _,size=m:GetBoundingBox() local name=m:GetAttribute('PetDefinitionName') local beforeScale=m:GetAttribute('GrowthQCBaselineModelScale') or 0 local beforeHeight=m:GetAttribute('GrowthQCBaselineHeight') or 0 local target=m:GetAttribute('CompanionTargetHeight') local beforeTarget=m:GetAttribute('GrowthQCBaselineTargetHeight') local notLarger=m:GetScale()<=beforeScale+.012 and size.Y<=beforeHeight+.035 local targetFixed=target==beforeTarget identities=identities and expected[name]==true and seen[name]~=true seen[name]=true fixed=fixed and notLarger and targetFixed rows[#rows+1]={name=name,beforeScale=beforeScale,afterScale=m:GetScale(),beforeHeight=beforeHeight,afterHeight=size.Y,notLarger=notLarger,targetFixed=targetFixed} m:SetAttribute('GrowthQCBaselineModelScale',nil) m:SetAttribute('GrowthQCBaselineHeight',nil) m:SetAttribute('GrowthQCBaselineTargetHeight',nil) end end for name in pairs(expected) do identities=identities and seen[name]==true end local applied=character:GetAttribute('PowerGrowthAppliedMultiplier') or 0 local valid=folder and #rows==3 and fixed and identities and applied>1.18 and character:GetAttribute('PowerGrowthPetScalePolicy')=='IndependentFixedTarget' local result={valid=valid==true,count=#rows,fixed=fixed,exactIdentities=identities,heroMultiplier=applied,policy=character:GetAttribute('PowerGrowthPetScalePolicy'),rows=rows} assert(valid,'Pet growth invariant failed '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)

steps.label: pets do not grow when hero Power grows

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] local character=p.Character local high=character:GetAttribute('PowerGrowthAppliedMultiplier') or 0 c:Invoke('SetStats',{Power=15,WallLevel=99}) local deadline=os.clock()+2 repeat task.wait(.05) until os.clock()>=deadline or (character:GetAttribute('PowerGrowthAppliedMultiplier') or 99)<=1.01 local low=character:GetAttribute('PowerGrowthAppliedMultiplier') or 99 local lowBody=character:GetAttribute('PowerGrowthBodyHeight') or 99 c:Invoke('SetStats',{Power=1.5e9}) deadline=os.clock()+2 repeat task.wait(.05) until os.clock()>=deadline or (character:GetAttribute('PowerGrowthAppliedMultiplier') or 0)>1.18 local restored=character:GetAttribute('PowerGrowthAppliedMultiplier') or 0 local valid=high>1.18 and low<=1.01 and restored>1.18 and lowBody<=character:GetAttribute('PowerGrowthMaximumHeight')+.05 local result={valid=valid,high=high,low=low,restored=restored,wallLevel=p.leaderstats.WallLevel.Value,lowBody=lowBody} assert(valid,'Power growth downscale/restore failed '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)

steps.label: hero shrinks back at low Power and grows again independently of WallLevel

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local character=p.Character local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid') local gui=p.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local automation=gui.PunchWallClientAutomation automation:Invoke('ResetCamera') task.wait(.2) local metrics=automation:Invoke('__RunCamera',6) local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera local cf,size=character:GetBoundingBox() local visible=0 local total=0 for _,sx in ipairs({-1,1}) do for _,sy in ipairs({-1,1}) do for _,sz in ipairs({-1,1}) do total+=1 local world=cf:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(size.X*sx*.5,size.Y*sy*.5,size.Z*sz*.5)) local point,onScreen=camera:WorldToViewportPoint(world) if onScreen and point.Z>0 and point.X>=0 and point.X<=camera.ViewportSize.X and point.Y>=0 and point.Y<=camera.ViewportSize.Y then visible+=1 end end end end local valid=type(metrics)=='table' and metrics.valid==true and metrics.visualValid==true and metrics.initialOrbitSettled==true and metrics.settleTimedOut~=true and metrics.inside==0 and metrics.type=='Custom' and camera.CameraSubject==humanoid and visible==total and (character:GetAttribute('PowerGrowthAppliedMultiplier') or 0)>1.18 local result={valid=valid,visibleCorners=visible,totalCorners=total,cameraType=tostring(camera.CameraType),subjectCurrent=camera.CameraSubject==humanoid,inside=type(metrics)=='table' and metrics.inside or -1,visualValid=type(metrics)=='table' and metrics.visualValid or false,settled=type(metrics)=='table' and metrics.initialOrbitSettled or false,heroMultiplier=character:GetAttribute('PowerGrowthAppliedMultiplier')} assert(valid,'Power growth camera framing failed '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)

steps.label: maximum-size hero remains fully framed by the live camera

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local character=p.Character local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild(p.Name..' Client Companions') local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera local function rectFor(cf,size) local minX,minY,maxX,maxY=math.huge,math.huge,-math.huge,-math.huge local visible=0 for _,sx in ipairs({-1,1}) do for _,sy in ipairs({-1,1}) do for _,sz in ipairs({-1,1}) do local point,on=cam:WorldToViewportPoint(cf:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(size.X*sx*.5,size.Y*sy*.5,size.Z*sz*.5))) if on and point.Z>0 then visible+=1 end minX=math.min(minX,point.X) minY=math.min(minY,point.Y) maxX=math.max(maxX,point.X) maxY=math.max(maxY,point.Y) end end end return {minX=minX,minY=minY,maxX=maxX,maxY=maxY,visible=visible} end local function overlap(a,b) local w=math.max(0,math.min(a.maxX,b.maxX)-math.max(a.minX,b.minX)) local h=math.max(0,math.min(a.maxY,b.maxY)-math.max(a.minY,b.minY)) local area=w*h local aa=math.max((a.maxX-a.minX)*(a.maxY-a.minY),1) local ab=math.max((b.maxX-b.minX)*(b.maxY-b.minY),1) return area/math.min(aa,ab) end local avatarCf,avatarSize=character:GetBoundingBox() local avatarRect=rectFor(avatarCf,avatarSize) local pets={} local allSafe=true for _,m in ipairs(folder and folder:GetChildren() or {}) do if m:IsA('Model') then local cf,size=m:GetBoundingBox() local rect=rectFor(cf,size) allSafe=allSafe and rect.visible==8 and rect.minX>=0 and rect.minY>=0 and rect.maxX<=cam.ViewportSize.X and rect.maxY<=cam.ViewportSize.Y pets[#pets+1]={name=m:GetAttribute('PetDefinitionName'),rect=rect,position=cf.Position} end end local maxAvatarOverlap=0 local maxPairOverlap=0 local minPair=99 for i=1,#pets do maxAvatarOverlap=math.max(maxAvatarOverlap,overlap(pets[i].rect,avatarRect)) for j=i+1,#pets do maxPairOverlap=math.max(maxPairOverlap,overlap(pets[i].rect,pets[j].rect)) minPair=math.min(minPair,(pets[i].position-pets[j].position).Magnitude) end end local valid=#pets==3 and allSafe and maxAvatarOverlap<=.35 and maxPairOverlap<=.15 and minPair>=1.35 local result={valid=valid,count=#pets,allSafe=allSafe,maxAvatarOverlap=maxAvatarOverlap,maxPairOverlap=maxPairOverlap,minWorldPair=minPair} assert(valid,'Power growth companion overlap/safe-frame failed '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)

steps.label: maximum-size hero and pets remain separated inside the camera safe frame

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] c:Invoke('SetStats',{Power=1.5e9}) local old=p.Character c:Invoke('Respawn') local deadline=os.clock()+3 repeat task.wait(.05) until os.clock()>=deadline or (p.Character~=old and (p.Character:GetAttribute('PowerGrowthAppliedMultiplier') or 0)>1.18) local character=p.Character local _,size=character:GetBoundingBox() local world=workspace.PunchWallRPG local block=world['Depth Blocks'].DepthBlock_L001_C06_R01 local boss=world.Walls['Titan Server Wall'] local passageHeight=block.Size.Y*2 local applied=character:GetAttribute('PowerGrowthAppliedMultiplier') or 0 local valid=character~=old and applied>1.18 and (character:GetAttribute('PowerGrowthBodyHeight') or 99)<=passageHeight-.75 and size.Y<=boss.Size.Y-1.2 and character:GetAttribute('PowerGrowthPower')==1.5e9 return H:JSONEncode({valid=valid,newCharacter=character~=old,applied=applied,bodyHeight=character:GetAttribute('PowerGrowthBodyHeight'),visualHeight=size.Y,passageHeight=passageHeight,bossWallHeight=boss.Size.Y,power=character:GetAttribute('PowerGrowthPower'),generation=p:GetAttribute('PowerGrowthGeneration')})

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local character=p.Character local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid') local deadline=os.clock()+2 repeat task.wait(.05) until os.clock()>=deadline or workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject==humanoid local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild(p.Name..' Client Companions') local expected={['Forest Pup']=true,['Miner Cat']=true,['Crystal Fox']=true} local seen={} local count=0 local identities=true for _,m in ipairs(folder and folder:GetChildren() or {}) do if m:IsA('Model') then local name=m:GetAttribute('PetDefinitionName') identities=identities and expected[name]==true and seen[name]~=true seen[name]=true count+=1 end end for name in pairs(expected) do identities=identities and seen[name]==true end local valid=character~=nil and humanoid~=nil and workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject==humanoid and count==3 and identities local result={valid=valid,subjectCurrent=workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject==humanoid,count=count,exactIdentities=identities,heroMultiplier=character and character:GetAttribute('PowerGrowthAppliedMultiplier') or 0} assert(valid,'Post-respawn client rebuild failed '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)
